report.summary: Partial collapse of a five-storey apartment building with dust covering the street and neighbours reporting that some residents may still be inside.

reported.text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed.
Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

guidance.text: Aftershocks can increase the tilt of a leaning story until collapse; re‑evaluate buildings after aftershocks using indicator buildings.
Establish a collapse shadow cordon as a wedge or limited rectangle in the direction the building may fall, based on the likely collapse mode and damage.

basis.text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed.
Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

risks.text: Aftershocks could cause further collapse of the damaged structure.
Trapped occupants may be injured or succumb to hazards such as dust and unstable debris.

possibly_affected.text: Residents inside the collapsed section of the building.
Pedestrians and neighbours on the adjacent street exposed to dust and falling debris.

recommendations.text: Aftershocks can increase the tilt of a leaning story until collapse; re‑evaluate buildings after aftershocks using indicator buildings.
Establish a collapse shadow cordon as a wedge or limited rectangle in the direction the building may fall, based on the likely collapse mode and damage.

uncertainties: Exact extent of the structural collapse.
Number of occupants possibly trapped inside.
Potential for aftershocks in the area.
information_needed: Details on the building’s structural system and age.
Confirmation of any aftershock activity reported by seismic monitoring.
report.disclaimer: This report is preliminary and should not be used as the sole basis for decision‑making; consult qualified professionals and authorities.
